Mr. Fulk’s Wild Ride: Travel in comfort, safety and style across the festival via our exclusive Golden Gate Club Stage to Stage Golf Cart Fleet. Feast and Imbibe: Complimentary all-day food and drink curated by the Bay Area's most celebrated culinary, cocktail, beer, and wine talents featuring Tyler Florence of Miller & Lux, Dana Younkin and Nancy Oakes of Boulevard, and James Beard Award finalist Melissa King. Skydeck Parlor at Lands End: Watch festival headliners from high above the crowd in a space created by AD100 Designer Ken Fulk. Dedicated Entrance: Come and go easily throughout the day using your own lane at the VIP Entrance. Personal Concierge Service: Dedicated concierge team to maximize your Outside Lands experience, including securing your optimal transportation plans. Coat Check, Charging Stations, Wi-Fi, Premium Air-Conditioned Restrooms, and Exclusive Festival Gift: Let us take care of the details while you enjoy the show in comfort. Night Show Access: Keep the party going with exclusive presale access to all Outside Lands Night Shows. LEARN MORE SHUTTLE PASS BUY NOW BEFORE PRICE INCREASES 3-Day starting at $84 ALL IN Single Day starting at $37.75 ALL IN BUY SHUTTLE PASSES 3-Day $84 ALL IN TIER 1 TIER 2 $72 $84 Single Day $37.75 ALL IN TIER 1 $37.75 Outside Lands is proud to offer a pre-paid, roundtrip shuttle service from the Bill Graham Civic Auditorium in the heart of San Francisco to the south entrance of Outside Lands in Golden Gate Park. The shuttles are coach-style buses that offer a comfortable ride to and from the festival each day. Shuttles begin running each day at 11 AM and run continuously all day with limited coverage from 5-8 PM. The last shuttle to the festival leaves Bill Graham Civic Auditorium at 8pm. Return shuttles run until one hour after the music ends each night. The Bill Graham Civic Auditorium is located next to Civic Center Plaza, near BART, MUNI, and Caltrain stops. We suggest taking public transportation to the Bill Graham Civic Auditorium, as parking is not included in the price of your shuttle pass. If you do drive, parking may be available in the Civic Center Parking Garage adjacent to the Bill Graham Civic for a fee. The garage entrance is located at McAllister Street between Polk Street and Larkin Street.
